meta.about: Ski areas listed for ticket E (2026-11-12). Season text comes only from each area's official site, read on the date given; where the site gives no months it says 待核 / to be checked.

fields.season_en: The official home page says it reopens on 11 June (2027 season); the closing date is not given (to be checked).
fields.season_zh: 官网首页写 6 月 11 日重新开放（2027 雪季）；闭季日期未写，待核。
fields.road_en: The access road is unsealed; depending on the vehicle, chains may be needed, and rental cover may exclude alpine roads and chains. Check the Snow Report before going up.
fields.road_zh: 上山路是未铺装的砂石路；视车辆可能需要装防滑链，租车保险不一定覆盖高山路段和防滑链。上山前看滑雪场的每日雪况报告。

fields.season_en: The resort's own guide says the Queenstown-area ski season typically runs from mid-June to early October, depending on snow.
fields.season_zh: 滑雪场官网的雪季说明：皇后镇一带雪季通常从 6 月中到 10 月初，视降雪而定。

fields.season_en: The official site gives no season months for Treble Cone itself (to be checked); the same operator's guide gives mid-June to early October for the ski fields around Queenstown and Wānaka.
fields.season_zh: 官网没有单独写三锥山的雪季月份，待核；同一运营方的官网说明称皇后镇、瓦纳卡一带通常 6 月中到 10 月初。

fields.season_en: The official site gives no season months (to be checked); the Cardrona guide above gives mid-June to early October for the Queenstown area.
fields.season_zh: 官网没有写雪季月份，待核；上面 Cardrona 官网的说明称皇后镇一带通常 6 月中到 10 月初。

fields.season_en: The official site gives no season months (to be checked); the Cardrona guide above gives mid-June to early October for the Queenstown area.
fields.season_zh: 官网没有写雪季月份，待核；Cardrona 官网的说明称皇后镇一带通常 6 月中到 10 月初。

fields.name_zh: 鲁阿佩胡山滑雪场（华卡帕帕、图罗阿）
fields.town_zh: 华卡帕帕村／国家公园村
fields.season_en: Whakapapa's official site lists its winter season as May to October, with skiing terrain opening progressively.
fields.season_zh: 华卡帕帕官网：冬季为 5 月到 10 月，雪道随雪况逐步开放。

fields.season_en: The official site gives the 2026 season as 27 June to 20 September.
fields.season_zh: 官网：2026 雪季为 6 月 27 日到 9 月 20 日。
